action: Published r07: downed teammates can be dragged clear, and the status strip reports haul/bleed/role
result: Tag floodline/riveter/r07-a9d07bfbd5fa. action: Published r10: company steadies people, and survivors stop standing on each other
result: Tag floodline/riveter/r10-34766844bd2f. Place 937,858 B sha256 34766844bd2f...; 60/60 compiled, 28/28 static, 48/48 headless, 15/15 client, bots 5W/2F/0P/0U over 7 rounds; ZIP 244,356 B / 53 entries sha df1d3857f6f4. New: a rescuer within 12 studs calms a survivor 2.1x faster and heals 1.6 hp/s, survivors within 9 studs calm each other 1.35x; grouped/groupCount on the record and snapshot; roster reads "Idle +2" and counts who is steadied. Scenario 48, written to prove the ratios, caught a real bug instead: groundHeight ignored only the subject model, so two survivors standing together raycast each others bodies and levitated at 38 studs/s. The ground ray now ignores every body and character. Fixing it removed an accidental levitation safety net, so the two hardest bot rounds (2p Storm, 4p Catastrophe) now fail where r09 won one of them; 1p Calm/Standard/Storm, 2p Standard and 4p Standard still win. Studio runtime remains NOT RUN.
